title: Used to / Would / Be Used to — Intermediate

questions.def: «used to» + infinitiv oʻtmishdagi, hozir takrorlanmaydigan odatni bildiradi.
questions.question: I ___ to play football every day after school.

questions.def: «used to» oʻtmishdagi odatni koʻrsatadi; «but now» uning tugaganini bildiradi.
questions.question: She ___ get up early, but now she sleeps in.

questions.def: Oʻtmishdagi holat «used to + infinitiv» bilan beriladi; «would» holat uchun ishlatilmaydi.
questions.question: He ___ in London before moving to Rome.

questions.def: «be used to» (am used to) biror narsaga oʻrganib qolganlikni bildiradi.
questions.question: I ___ to the noise after living here for a year.

questions.def: «be used to» dan keyin gerundiy keladi: is used to eating — koʻnikkan.
questions.question: She ___ eating spicy food.

questions.def: «would + infinitiv» oʻtmishda takrorlangan harakatni bildiradi; «when they were young» kontekst beradi.
questions.question: They ___ late every night when they were young.

questions.def: «would + infinitiv» oʻtmishda qayta-qayta takrorlangan harakatni bildiradi.
questions.question: My grandfather ___ tell us stories every evening.

questions.def: Inkor shakli «didn't use to»: «did» dan keyin feʼl asos shaklda qoladi.
questions.question: He ___ like coffee, but now he loves it.

questions.def: «did» dan keyin feʼl asos shaklda boʻladi: did you use to live.
questions.question: Did you used to live in Spain when you were young?

questions.def: «used to walk» oʻtmishdagi odat; hozir esa avtobusda qatnaydi.
questions.question: She ___ to school, but now she takes the bus.

questions.def: «am not used to» biror narsaga hali koʻnikmaganlikni bildiradi.
questions.question: I ___ to the cold weather here.

questions.def: «used to go» oʻtmishda muntazam borganini bildiradi; «are used to» dan keyin gerundiy kerak.
questions.question: They ___ go to that restaurant.

questions.def: «used to eat» oʻtmishdagi odat; «when I was a child» oʻtmish zamonni koʻrsatadi.
questions.question: I ___ so much sugar when I was a child.

questions.def: «used to» oʻtmishdagi takroriy holatni bildiradi; «is/was used to» dan keyin gerundiy kerak.
questions.question: She ___ get nervous before exams.

questions.def: «would + infinitiv» oʻtmishdagi takroriy harakat (har yakshanba) uchun ishlatiladi.
questions.question: He ___ visit his grandmother every Sunday.

questions.def: «would drink» oʻtmishdagi odatiy harakat; «used to» dan keyin infinitiv kerak, gerundiy emas.
questions.question: They ___ coffee after dinner.

questions.def: Oʻtmishdagi holat «used to + be» bilan beriladi; «be used to» dan keyin gerundiy kerak.
questions.question: They ___ be afraid of the dark.

questions.def: «used to walk» oʻtmishdagi odat, hozir esa mashina haydaydi.
questions.question: He ___ walk to work, but now he drives.

questions.def: «would play» oʻtmishda har kuni takrorlangan harakatni bildiradi.
questions.question: He ___ the guitar every day after school.

questions.def: «am used to + gerundiy» kichik shaharda yashashga koʻnikkanlikni bildiradi.
questions.question: I ___ living in a small town.

questions.def: «used to have» oʻtmishdagi holat; keyin u oʻzgargan — sochini kesdi.
questions.question: She ___ have long hair, but she cut it.

questions.def: «would read» oʻtmishdagi takroriy odatni bildiradi.
questions.question: She ___ books before bed.

questions.def: Inkor odat «didn't use to» bilan beriladi; «did» dan keyin «use» asos shaklda.
questions.question: We ___ get up early on weekends.

questions.def: «aren't used to» bunday havoga koʻnikmaganlikni bildiradi; keyin ot yoki gerundiy keladi.
questions.question: They ___ this kind of weather.

questions.def: «used to + infinitiv» hozir mavjud boʻlmagan oʻtmish holatini bildiradi.
questions.question: I ___ have long hair, but now it's short.

questions.def: «is used to + gerundiy» erta turishga koʻnikkanini bildiradi.
questions.question: He ___ getting up early for work.

questions.def: «used to live» oʻtmishdagi yashash holatini bildiradi; bu holat endi tugagan.
questions.question: She ___ in Paris before moving to Rome.

questions.def: «would + infinitiv» oʻtmishdagi takroriy harakatni — hikoya qilib berishni bildiradi.
questions.question: My grandmother ___ tell me stories about her childhood.

questions.def: «be used to» koʻnikkanlikni bildiradi: shovqinni endi sezmaydi.
questions.question: I'm ___ the noise now; I don't even notice it.

questions.def: «used to work» oʻtmishdagi odat; «but I don't anymore» uning tugaganini koʻrsatadi.
questions.question: I ___ late, but I don't anymore.
